newsitem.title: USA: Incomnet reaches preliminary pact in suit.
newsitem.headline: Incomnet reaches preliminary pact in suit.

text.p: Incomnet Inc said former chief executive officer and president Sam Schwartz will pay the company $4.25 million in cash and stock under a preliminary settlement of a pending lawsuit.

The company said the case was brought by a shareholder of Incomnet on behalf of the company to recover short-swing profits from Schwartz that resulted from purchases and sales of Incomnet common stock by Schwartz and affiliates.
Under the agreement, Mr. Schwartz will pay Incomnet $600,000 in cash and tender stock worth $3.65 million, the company said in a news release.
The settlement is subject to final court approval on May 30.
Incomnet said shareholders will be able to comment on the settlement, which will be outlined in a notice sent April 21.
President Mel Reznick said that the preliminary settlement represents a positive step in efforts to resolve litigation based on allegations regarding trading activity by Schwartz.
